description:
FILED s526w2 (Opus, resumed s528 2026-10-25), from the Template-Toolkit-3.106 board census.  NOT REDUCED; downstream of #3856.

  `require Template::Parser` fails ("Failed to transpile .../Template/Parser.pm", PCL: cannot compile interpolated regex reference '${ ... }' = #3856).  Template->new still works (probe scratch/s526w2/ptt1.pl: "ok Template=HASH(0x1)"), but the first ->process fails ("file error - Can't call method "process" on unblessed reference", ptt2.pl) and then:
   - t/anycase.t (and 68 more, rc=0 on the board, no TAP): `use Template::Test` path dies with SBCL "Binding stack exhausted" -- a method-call loop, backtrace frames alternate (LAMBDA ...) / P-METHOD-CALL with arguments (1, undef) -- after 24 s warm (scratch/s526w2/tt-anycase.out);
   - t/block.t (and 28 more, rc=124 TIMEOUT at 120 s on the board): still running at 300 s warm (tt-block.out empty) -- a HANG.
  perl runs all of these (prove -b: 121 files, 3144 tests, PASS; 14 PERL-SKIPs).
WHAT TO DO: re-measure after #3856 lands -- if the parser loads, these files may simply run.  If they still hang, the hang is its own bug: a recursion / loop on an error path (perl would die with "Deep recursion" only as a warning, so a real perl loop would also hang -- check that perl does NOT reach this path because the parser loads there).


=== DONE (s530b, Opus, 2026-10-31): BOTH halves measured and gone ===
Re-measured after #3856 (main 5faf9c8f): the 29 hangs + 69 deaths SURVIVED (3 / 10 / 108, 144 ok, 31 TIMEOUT) -- Template::Parser now transpiled but died at LOAD on #4080 (`$TAG_STYLE->{template} = ...` through a file-level `our` in a package lowered to p-scalar-=).  The binding-stack loop REDUCED to #4081: Template::Test's exported `ok` was installed over pcl's own pl-ok (the runtime's TAP function), and Test::Builder's ->ok calls pl-ok -> Template::Test::ok -> $TB->ok ... (the backtrace's (1, "running test_expect()") frames).  The hangs were the same files waiting on that path (t/block.t: a hang on main, 12 s with #4080 fixed and the loop alone, 15/2 with all three fillers).  With #4080 #4081 #4082 (the slice-flatten fix that made TT's keywords lex): 57 PASS / 45 PARTIAL / 19 FAIL, 2,085 ok, ZERO TIMEOUTs and ZERO binding-stack deaths over the 121 files.  Template-Toolkit joined the board (s530b).
